added_claim_errors: '还会进黑名单' for proxy study or proxy exams: unverifiable. Order 163 Art. 31 (gov.cn text, which I opened) gives revocation, restored points and a fine of up to 1000 yuan, and Art. 26 bars applying for three periods. It mentions no blacklist.
'多数城市只开了网上学习': unverifiable generalisation with no source.
'申请、审核、实人认证 约5分钟' per round: there is no official figure for review time, so this implies a review speed nobody has published (though it is hedged as approximate).
'一轮走完才能开下一轮，不能先攒3小时学习时间再连考6次': not stated in the cited Beijing guide; plausible but unverified (partly hedged by '以APP为准').

reasons: Both answers open by correcting the premise: at most 6 points can be removed, so the driver goes from 10 down to 4. Both also explain that remaining points are cleared on the reset date anyway, that 8 more points would bring the total to 12, and they get the 3-hour learning arithmetic right. B covers more of the key. It gives the 2-retake rule, the 7-working-day exam window and the 5-minute minimum session, all of which I confirmed on its cited Beijing traffic page. It also includes on-site learning (2 points for 1 hour), the check that violations are processed, and the fraud penalties that match Art. 31. A has no on-site learning or public-welfare route at all, and its retake guidance is vague. B is much longer than the request needs and adds a few unverifiable extras (a blacklist, 'most cities'), so its edge is only slight.
